newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management to buy Superior Forge.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management to buy Superior Forge.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Wednesday it would acquire Superior Forge Inc, an aluminum user and producer, for 1,080,000 shares and $1.8 million cash.

Superior Forge, based in Huntington Beach, Calif., has estimated gross revenues of $15 million a year, Metal Management said. The merger, along with other deals recently announced by Metal Management, will lift gross revenues to more than $725 million.

Metal Management said it signed a binding letter of intent to acquire Superior Forge. Under the deal, Superior Chairman and Vice President Ian Albert will become a member of the office of the president at Metal Management and president and chief executive of Superior.
In addition Alan Shumway, controller of Superior, will serve as vice president of finance at Superior.

"This is part of Metal Management's continued game plan to develop regional strength in each facet of our recycling operations. This acquisition shows our continued commitment to our non-ferrous business," said T. Benjamin Jennings, Metal Management's chairman and chief development officer.
